P201  NERD-TEXT 201   14.11.26 12:11 UTC
========================================
SECURITY ADVISORY (1/5)                 
========================================
> CVE-2026-114713                       
  UnrealIRCd: Command Injection         
                                        
  CISA added an UnrealIRCd delimiter    
  flaw to its KEV catalog. The bug      
  enables users in linked multi-server  
  setups to inject arbitrary server-to- 
  server commands with elevated         
  privileges without auth.              
                                        
  CISA KEV | Added: 2026-11-13 | Due:   
  2026-11-16

========================================
SECURITY ADVISORY (2/5)                 
========================================
> CVE-2026-123039                       
  Check Point: Permission Flaw          
                                        
  A critical permissions flaw hits      
  multiple Check Point gateway and      
  management appliances. The bug permits
  unauthorized resource tampering,      
  prompting CISA to mandate remediation 
  under catalog rules.                  
                                        
  CISA KEV | Added: 2026-11-13 | Due:   
  2026-11-16

P203  NERD-TEXT 203   14.11.26 12:11 UTC
========================================
SECURITY ADVISORY (3/5)                 
========================================
> CVE-2026-124194                       
  Outlook: Remote Spoofing Bug          
                                        
  CISA warns of an Outlook vulnerability
  stemming from missing user interaction
  checks. Remote attackers can conduct  
  network-level spoofing attacks against
  unpatched systems without operator    
  consent.                              
                                        
  CISA KEV | Added: 2026-11-10 | Due:   
  2026-11-24

SECURITY ADVISORY (4/5)                 
========================================
> DEBIAN DSA                            
  Debian: Linux Kernel Patched          
                                        
  Debian has issued DSA-6628-1 to       
  address multiple security             
  vulnerabilities across the Linux      
  kernel. Upgrading installed linux     
  packages is urgently advised to avert 
  privilege escalation and crashes.     
                                        
  Source: Debian DSA (2026-11-13)

SECURITY ADVISORY (5/5)                 
========================================
> UBUNTU USN                            
  Ubuntu: FIPS Kernel Fixed             
                                        
  Canonical released USN-9027-2 for     
  Ubuntu FIPS kernels. The maintenance  
  update fixes several flaws that remote
  or local attackers could exploit to   
  compromise target nodes and escalate  
  system rights.                        
                                        
  Source: Ubuntu USN (Fri, 13 Nov 2026)
